steps.name: Start Mattermost, GitLab, and the runner
Install E2E dependencies
steps.run:
cd "$E2E_DIR"
npm ci
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

steps.name: Wait for the servers to be healthy
steps.run:
while [ ! -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/server-up.exit" ]; do sleep 5; done
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/server-up.log"
exit "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/server-up.exit")"

steps.name: Collect container logs
steps.run:
cd "$E2E_DIR"
mkdir -p results
docker compose ps -a > results/containers.txt
docker compose logs --no-color > results/containers.log
